title: Yehudah Mar bar Mareimar

paragraphs: Yehudah Mar bar Mareimar. A great scholar in Rav Papa’s time and Rava’s student: Ketubot 80b has him transmitting Rava’s teaching, with Rav Papa explaining that Yehudah’s statement was not explicitly stated. In 53a there, Rav Papa went to Abba of Sura to write a ketubah for his son. Yehudah [Mar] bar Mareimar came out, and Rav Papa asked him to accompany him inside. His presence led Abba of Sura to assign all his property to his daughter. Bava Metzia 101a has Yehudah [Mar, according to Dikdukei Soferim] bar Mareimar telling his servant: “Hire for me,” etc.

notes.text: Hyman’s square-bracketed Mar variants are retained. Yehudah’s presence caused the father to assign property to his daughter; the account does not say that Yehudah himself gave the property.

The consulted Davidson account begins at Ketubot 52b and continues on 53a; 52b names Yehudah bar Mareimar without Mar. The supplied 53a locator and bracketed Mar are retained as Hyman’s presentation. The father assigns the property; Yehudah’s presence is the occasion, not a donation by Yehudah. Exact Dikdukei Soferim readings remain attributed.
